title: Console feature funnel: canonical fact/dimension model and curated tables for usage analytics
creator: Amina Patel
description: We need a single, well-documented canonical model in the data warehouse that powers product analytics for Console feature funnels, onboarding flows, and feature adoption dashboards. This ticket covers the schema proposal, ETL contract from Console backend services, transformation logic (incremental merge rules), performance/partitioning strategy, and a curated set of materialized tables exposed to analytics/BI teams. The goal is to replace ad-hoc views and brittle joins with a small set of stable curated tables that are easy to consume from Looker/Metabase and are performant at scale.
acceptance_criteria: Schema proposal for factorized model (one event fact + minimal canonical dims) is reviewed and approved by Analytics and Backend owners
ETL contract documented: event names, required fields, idempotency semantics, event dedupe keys, and enrichment fields (workspace_plan, region, billing_tier)
Core curated tables implemented in BigQuery: console_event_fact, workspace_dim, feature_variant_dim, daily_workspace_usage_rollup
Materialized view or scheduled incremental MERGE created for console_event_fact with monthly partitions, clustering on workspace_id and event_type
Backfill and validation queries included; automated data quality checks (row counts, null rates, high-cardinality alerts) added to data platform job
Latency SLO: new pipeline should surface events in curated tables within 5 minutes of ingestion for 95% of events in steady-state
Dashboard owners (Growth/Platform) sign off on the sample dashboards powered by the curated tables
schema_proposal: High-level model: 1) console_event_fact (event_time_iso, event_id, workspace_id, user_hashed_id, event_type, feature_area, route, duration_ms, success_flag, meta_json, ingestion_source, ingested_at), partitioned by DATE(event_time_iso) (monthly partitions) and clustered by workspace_id,event_type; 2) workspace_dim (workspace_id, org_name, plan_tier, created_at, region, team_count); 3) feature_variant_dim (feature_area, variant_id, description, enabled_since); 4) daily_workspace_usage_rollup (date, workspace_id, events_count, unique_users, avg_session_duration_ms, tokens_generated) - pre-aggregated for frequent dashboards.
etl_contract_summary: Console backend will emit structured events to the analytics ingestion topic (pubsub/kafka) with fields: event_id (uuid), event_time (iso8601), workspace_id, user_id (SHA256 hashed by backend), event_type (enum), feature_area (string), route (string), duration_ms (nullable), success (boolean), properties (json). Consumer must upsert to staging.console_events_staging using event_id as dedupe key. Staging schema must include ingestion_id and ingestion_time. The transformer will enrich with workspace metadata from raw workspaces table and map plan tiers.
transformation_notes:
- Use BigQuery MERGE for incremental upserts keyed on event_id; use ingestion_time watermark to avoid reprocessing old events.
- For late-arriving events (older than 2 days) write to a special late_events table and trigger a targeted backfill job into the fact.
- Compute derived fields (session_id via sessionization logic using user_hashed_id and 30-minute inactivity gap) in a scheduled daily job and store session_id in the rollup table.
- Keep raw messages in raw.console_events_raw for 90 days, staging for 30 days, curated for 13 months (policy).
partitioning_and_performance: Recommended: monthly partitioning on DATE(event_time_iso) to support long retention with low partition counts. Cluster on workspace_id, event_type to accelerate common filters. Use materialized views for daily_workspace_usage_rollup where possible or scheduled daily batch writes to a dedicated curated table. Estimate storage: 120M events/month => recommend sharded write jobs with parallel workers and streaming buffer disabled for large backfills.
sample_queries:
-- Top features by MAU for the last 30 days
SELECT feature_area, COUNT(DISTINCT user_hashed_id) AS mau
FROM curated.console_event_fact
WHERE event_time_iso >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
GROUP BY feature_area
ORDER BY mau DESC
LIMIT 50

-- Funnel conversion (open -> start -> complete) by feature_area
WITH events AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, user_hashed_id, event_type, event_time_iso
  FROM curated.console_event_fact
  WHERE event_time_iso BETWEEN @start AND @end
),
steps AS (
  SELECT user_hashed_id, feature_area,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS opened,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'start' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS started,
    MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'complete' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed
  FROM events
  GROUP BY user_hashed_id, feature_area
)
SELECT feature_area, SUM(opened) AS opened, SUM(started) AS started, SUM(completed) AS completed, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(started), SUM(opened)), 2) AS start_rate, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(completed), SUM(started)), 2) AS completion_rate
FROM steps
GROUP BY feature_area
ORDER BY opened DESC

-- Validate idempotency: count duplicates of event_id in curated layer
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) AS duplicates
FROM curated.console_event_fact
WHERE DATE(event_time_iso) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
backfill_strategy: 1) Backfill raw data into raw.console_events_raw for missing historic range. 2) Run dedupe and staging loads with MERGE into staging.console_events_staging. 3) Incrementally MERGE into curated.console_event_fact by month, starting from oldest to newest to keep writes idempotent. 4) Run validation queries after each month and only promote the month to production_curated if validations pass. Expect backfill throughput ~10M events/hour using 16 parallel workers.
data_quality_checks:
- Daily row count vs. expected source publish counts (tolerance 5%)
- Null-rate on mandatory fields (event_id, event_time_iso, workspace_id) < 0.1%
- Duplicate rate (event_id) < 0.01%
- High-cardinality alerting for any field where unique values increase > 10x week-over-week
- Sessionization drift checks: median session length should be stable within 30% rolling window
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for SQL transformations (dbt tests or BQ assertions) covering uniqueness, non-null constraints, and referential joins to workspace_dim.
- Staging pipeline will run on a representative 1% sample of production traffic for a week.
- Run synthetic event replay (10k events/day) to validate end-to-end latency and idempotency.
- Peer review of schema and transformation queries by Analytics Eng and Backend team.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): deploy curated tables and point internal Growth dashboards to the new daily_workspace_usage_rollup for a subset of workspaces (by tag). Monitor data quality and latency for 72 hours. Phase 2: promote additional dashboards and switch Looker explores to curated.console_event_fact (read-only). Phase 3: deprecate legacy views after 14 days of stable metrics and remove source queries referenced in old dashboards.
implementation_notes:
- Use dbt models for curated tables with materializations set to 'incremental' and custom MERGE SQL to support dedupe semantics.
- Use streaming ingestion for low-latency paths but ensure idempotent keys to avoid duplicates in streaming buffers.
- Add a schema version column in curated tables (schema_version = '2026-02-15_v1') to allow safe evolutions.
- Coordinate with Backend (topic schema) to add 'ingestion_id' to event payloads for exact-once semantics where feasible.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- Add dashboards: (1) ingestion lag (95th/99th percentile), (2) duplicate rate, (3) daily event counts by source, (4) table scan and query cost by curated table.
- Configure alerts to Slack + PagerDuty for: ingestion lag > 30m for 5 consecutive minutes, duplicate rate spike > 0.1%, QC test failures.
